declarations.name: Poincare.HamiltonScalarGradientEstimate.cubic_reaction_le_four_scalar_mul_traceless
declarations.lean_type: ∀ {M : Type u} [TopologicalSpace M] [T2Space M] [ChartedSpace (Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3) M] [IsManifold (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) ∞ M], ∀ (g : Poincare.ClosedSmoothRiemannianMetric 3 M) [CovariantDerivative.ContMDiffCovariantDerivative g.leviCivita 1] (x : M), 0 < g.scalarAt x → g.pinchingQuotientAt x ≤ 1 → g.pinchingTracelessRicciReactionTrace3At x (g.pinchingRicciNormReactionMotionTraceCubicAt x) ≤ 4 * g.scalarAt x * g.tracelessRicciNormSqAt x
